fields.title: Dentō Ichiba Saikai ni Kansuru Shū Chōkan Tsūchi (Official Notice on Traditional Market Reopening)

notice.subject: Dentō ichiba oyobi chiryōin no saikai kyoka ni tsuite
notice.reason: Eisei kensa no gōkaku oyobi kentei zumi no kisei junsyu ni motozuku.

fields.content: Kono tsūchi ni yori, Utari binti Arsad ga kanri suru dentō kusuri ichiba oyobi balai pengobatan no saikai o kyoka suru. Kango eisei kisei o junsyu suru koto ga motomerareru.

claims.fact: Kōshiki tsūchi wa shinsei no jyuri to ichiba saikai no kyoka o seishiki ni tsūchi shite iru.
